<thought>To satisfy the task I will propose a concise retrosynthetic route (≤ 6 steps) whose leaf nodes are simple, commercially available chemicals. I will verify that each leaf SMILES is buyable using the is_buyable tool. The route will consist of:  

1. Sulfonyl‑chloride coupling (sulfonylation) of an aniline.  
2. Buchwald‑Hartwig N‑arylation to attach the piperazine fragment.  
3. Boc‑deprotection of the piperazine nitrogen.  
4. Carbamate formation (Boc protection) on the second piperazine nitrogen.  
5. Construction of the fused bicyclic aryl core from a commercially available phenol via a Friedel‑Crafts alkylation.  

All precursors are inexpensive, widely stocked building blocks. I will now check their commercial availability.</thought>
